top_concerns: Claim of maximal expressivity / distinguishing all non-isomorphic CCs is false: L reduces to the graph Laplacian at rank<=1 and cospectral graphs (e.g. strongly regular) share HKS; Thm 4.1/4.3 proofs conflate orthogonal similarity with permutation isomorphism

Laplacian definition ill-specified: incidence with an arbitrary +1 node per hyperedge breaks permutation invariance and the Dirichlet-form claim; 2^-i weights make higher ranks numerically negligible with no ablation
Missing controls: no transformer + standard LapPE/RWPE/heat-kernel PE baselines or strong graph transformers; MolHIV metric mislabeled as ACC; only ties SMCN on glycan tasks; no ablations
Efficiency claims appear to exclude the O(n^3) eigendecomposition preprocessing; 'constant footprint' is misleading; scale tested only up to 100 cells
Expressivity evidence limited to author-built torus pairs designed against SMCN; no BREC/EXP/CSL tests; weak novelty vs weighted hypergraph Laplacians and spectral PEs
